name: hospedaje-fr08-monorepo
description: Procedimiento FR08 Control de habitaciones - Hospedaje Resort

scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build:backend && npm run build:frontend
scripts.dev: npm run build:shared && concurrently -n "backend,frontend" -c "blue,green" "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:frontend"
scripts.lint: npm run lint:shared && npm run lint:backend && npm run lint:frontend
scripts.test: npm run test:backend && npm run test:frontend
scripts.typecheck: npm --workspace=@hospedaje/shared run typecheck && npm --workspace=@hospedaje/backend run typecheck && npm --workspace=@hospedaje/frontend run typecheck
